_what: Invite friends by name and email (the Invite friends screen). `fact_prefix` is where each invite is kept (one row per invited email); `page` how many the table shows at a time; `max` how many a person may keep; `name_max` how long a name may be; `kind` names the email for the per-person sending limits (src/mail-settings.json). The email's words are `email`, the screen's words are `words`. A status is the first of `statuses` whose `when` is true, reading the invite's own facts.

email.subject: {inviter} thinks Trillion could help you
email.reward: Your link gives you {theirs} off your first payment.
email.reward_none: Open the link to see what it does.
email.footer: You got this because {inviter} typed your address. Nothing else is sent unless you join.

words.heading: Send an invite
words.body: Type a friend's name and email. Trillion emails them your link and shows here whether they joined.
words.empty: You have not invited anyone by email yet.
words.unreadable: Your invites could not be read just now. Try again in a moment.
words.remove_confirm: Remove this invite from the list? The email already sent stays sent.
words.yourself: That is your own email address.
words.full: You already have {max} invites. Remove some to invite more.
words.not_sent: The email could not be sent: {why}
words.no_link: Your link could not be made just now. Try again in a moment.
